action.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT vendor_id, strftime(bill_date, '%Y-%m') AS mon, SUM(amount) AS total FROM ap_bills WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND bill_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND bill_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY vendor_id, mon HAVING SUM(amount) > 3000) SELECT COUNT(*) AS vendor_count FROM (SELECT vendor_id FROM m GROUP BY vendor_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mon) = 6) v
